audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Ryze levels 1 through 6 (Ryze x5, then Skill, Skill). The page's own whys[] say the opposite: whys[1] 'true Skill', whys[2] 'neither of you holds a clean edge', whys[3] 'genuine stalemate', whys[4] 'he edges this window', whys[5] Nasus-favoured, whys[6] Ryze. The packet chart agrees with the prose, not the sides.
audit.why: 49.06% over 265 games is a coin flip, not a five-stage Ryze lane. Level 1 is genuinely Ryze (Nasus has no Wither yet); levels 2-5 are even; level 6 and first item are Nasus on Fury of the Sands and stacked Siphoning Strike; two items is Ryze on Seraph's.
audit.corrected: Ryze / Skill / Skill / Skill / Nasus / Nasus / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs for every changed row, with the ratings that invert alongside them.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Lvl 1 (no Wither), Lvl 3 (full Flux loop), Lvl 6 Nasus (Fury of the Sands, 120/100/80s), 2+ items Ryze (Seraph's). That is the real spike order for both champions.
audit.corrected: No spike edits; two phases[].why lines rewritten so the prose stops contradicting the corrected sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0].t claim 'Phase Rush ignores Wither's threat'. It does not — Wither is a Move Speed and Attack Speed decay that applies over time and drags you down through the Phase Rush burst. dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d carry no interaction at all, and dosFull[2].d invents a fifteen-second Wither cooldown.
audit.why: Kit: Wither is 700 range on 15/14/13/12/11s — it outranges Rune Prison and Spell Flux, both 615, which is exactly why the sequencing is root-first. Siphoning Strike carries the autoReset flag, so his commit is telegraphed by an attack wind-up, not a cast. Fury of the Sands carries percentHealth — stacking flat resistances is not the counter. Mirror-confirmed: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux and is otherwise a slow; every Rune Prison or Spell Flux cast resets Overload.
audit.corrected: Wither is 700 range on 11-15s and beats your 615; root through Flux before he casts it, and treat the Siphoning Strike wind-up as the step-back cue. Do not answer Fury of the Sands with raw armour.

audit.corrected: Concrete numbers pushed into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and phases[4].why.
